brainlife.desc: In development: polarisation-sensitive OCT data for one volume and slice, as MATLAB files (two channels and retardance).
brainlife.name: neuro/ps-oct

original.desc: [In Development] PS-OCT data, for one volume and slice.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Developing PS-OCT Apps; only a test App reads it so far.

**Not for:** Production analyses; the datatype is still in development.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.ps-oct.json

identifying_risks: Specimen IDs in .mat variables may link to a donor.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 2: human status depends on the specimen; participant-level tissue images carry no direct identifiers (Tier 2), non-human data is Tier 1.
sharing_cautions: Confirm species and donor consent terms before sharing human tissue images.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 when the specimen is non-human (e.g. mouse) or synthetic.
Tier 2 for human tissue linked to a donor or specimen code.

intended_use: Developing PS-OCT Apps; only a test App reads it so far.
not_suitable_for: Production analyses; the datatype is still in development.
